info.description: Independent bearer identity, active membership, RBAC/ABAC/ACL, deny precedence. Local text profile or external managed/scanned reference profile; production and zero-knowledge are unavailable. Response schemas are intentionally generic; this is a reference, not a generated SDK contract.
